title: Keto Gooey Russian Mars Bar Dumplings
description: A keto-friendly Russian dessert featuring Mars bars, with a jammy and gooey center, perfect for a date night. This dish is a creative twist on traditional Russian dumplings.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine almond flour, granulated sweetener, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together sour cream, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Fold in the chopped Mars bars and shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and reduce the heat to a simmer.
Using a cookie scoop, form the dough into balls and carefully add them to the pot.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve warm.
